# @streetturtle/opencode-context-progress Compact context usage widget for the OpenCode sidebar. ## What it shows - **Line 1:** context progress bar + percentage used - **Line 2:** consumed tokens / model context window / session cost ## How it works - Uses the latest assistant response with token data - Token count formula: `input + output + reasoning + cache.read + cache.write` - Context window is read from the active provider/model metadata - Bar color changes with usage: - normal (theme accent color): `< 70%` - warning: `>= 70%` - danger: `>= 90%` ## Install Requires OpenCode 2.0 or newer. ```sh opencode plugin add @streetturtle/opencode-context-progress ``` Project-only: add `"@streetturtle/opencode-context-progress"` to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`.
